rpc.multi_instructions.en-US: Enter the numbers of all that apply, comma-separated (e.g. "1,3"), or type a custom answer as plain text.
rpc.multi_instructions.zh-CN: 输入所有适用选项的编号，用逗号分隔（例如 "1,3"），或直接输入自定义回答。

notice.hidden.zh-CN: ask_user_question 已隐藏——按 {key} 重新打开

tool.prompt_snippet.en-US: Ask the user up to {maxQuestions} structured questions ({minOptions}-{maxOptions} options each) when requirements are ambiguous
tool.prompt_snippet.zh-CN: 当需求不明确时，向用户提出最多 {maxQuestions} 个结构化问题（每题 {minOptions}-{maxOptions} 个选项）

tool.guideline.1.en-US: Use ask_user_question whenever the user's request is underspecified and you cannot proceed without concrete decisions — you can ask up to {maxQuestions} questions per invocation.
tool.guideline.1.zh-CN: 当用户请求信息不足、必须获得明确决策才能继续时，使用 ask_user_question；每次最多可提 {maxQuestions} 个问题。

tool.guideline.2.en-US: Each question MUST have {minOptions}-{maxOptions} options. Every option requires a concise label (1-5 words) and a description explaining what the choice means or its trade-offs. The user can additionally type a custom answer via the automatically appended "Type something." row on every question, or press Esc to abandon the questionnaire. Do NOT author "Other" or "Type something." labels yourself — reserved labels are rejected at runtime.
tool.guideline.2.zh-CN: 每个问题必须有 {minOptions}-{maxOptions} 个选项。每个选项都要有简短标签（1-5 个词）和说明其含义或取舍的描述。每题都会自动附加“输入内容”行，用户也可按 Esc 放弃问卷。不要自行添加“Other”或“Type something.”标签；保留标签会在运行时被拒绝。

tool.guideline.3.en-US: Set multiSelect: true when multiple answers are valid. Provide an options[].preview markdown string when an option benefits from richer side-by-side context (mockups, code snippets, diagrams, configs) — single-select only. The custom-answer row is available on every question; in preview mode it expands to the full pane width while typing. If you recommend a specific option, make it the first option and append "(Recommended)" to its label.
tool.guideline.3.zh-CN: 当多个答案都可成立时设置 multiSelect: true。若选项适合用并排的丰富上下文比较（原型、代码片段、图表、配置），可提供 options[].preview Markdown 字符串；预览仅支持单选题。每题都支持自定义回答；在预览模式中输入时会扩展到面板全宽。若推荐某个选项，请将其放在第一项并在标签末尾添加“(Recommended)”。

tool.guideline.4.en-US: Do not stack multiple ask_user_question calls back-to-back — group all clarifying questions into one invocation.
tool.guideline.4.zh-CN: 不要连续多次调用 ask_user_question；请把所有澄清问题合并到一次调用中。

tool.description.en-US: Ask the user one or more structured questions during execution to gather preferences, clarify ambiguous instructions, obtain implementation decisions, or offer directional choices. Users can type a custom answer via the automatically appended "Type something." row on every question or press Esc to abandon the questionnaire; reserved labels are rejected at runtime. Use multiSelect: true when multiple answers are valid. Single-select options may include markdown previews for mockups, code, diagrams, or configuration comparisons.
tool.description.zh-CN: 在执行过程中向用户提出一个或多个结构化问题，用于收集偏好、澄清含糊指令、获取实现决策或提供方向选择。每题都会自动附加“输入内容”行供用户填写自定义回答，也可按 Esc 放弃问卷。保留标签会在运行时被拒绝。多个答案可同时成立时使用 multiSelect: true。单选选项可附带 Markdown 预览，用于比较原型、代码、图表或配置。

error.no_ui.en-US: Error: UI not available. The user never saw the questions; do not treat this as a decline. Ask the questions as plain chat text instead.
error.no_ui.zh-CN: 错误：当前没有可用 UI。用户从未看到这些问题；不要将其视为拒绝回答。请改用普通聊天文本提问。

error.no_custom_ui.en-US: Error: this client cannot render the questionnaire. The user never saw the questions; do not treat this as a decline. Ask the questions as plain chat text instead.
error.no_custom_ui.zh-CN: 错误：此客户端无法渲染问卷。用户从未看到这些问题；不要将其视为拒绝回答。请改用普通聊天文本提问。

error.session_load_failed.en-US: Error: the questionnaire UI failed to load. The user never saw the questions; do not treat this as a decline. Ask in plain chat text; restoring the tool may require repairing the installation and restarting Pi. (cause: {cause})
error.session_load_failed.zh-CN: 错误：问卷 UI 加载失败。用户从未看到这些问题；不要将其视为拒绝回答。请改用普通聊天文本提问；恢复此工具可能需要修复安装并重启 Pi。（原因：{cause}）

error.stale_module_cache.en-US: Error: the questionnaire UI cannot load because the module cache is stale. The user never saw the questions; do not treat this as a decline. Please restart Pi to restore the tool. (resolved namespace keys: {keys})
error.stale_module_cache.zh-CN: 错误：模块缓存已失效，问卷 UI 无法加载。用户从未看到这些问题；不要将其视为拒绝回答。请重启 Pi 以恢复此工具。（已解析的命名空间键：{keys}）

validation.no_questions.en-US: Error: At least one question is required
validation.no_questions.zh-CN: 错误：至少需要一个问题

validation.too_many_questions.en-US: Error: At most {maxQuestions} questions are allowed per invocation
validation.too_many_questions.zh-CN: 错误：每次调用最多允许 {maxQuestions} 个问题

validation.duplicate_question.en-US: Error: Question text must be unique within an invocation
validation.duplicate_question.zh-CN: 错误：一次调用中的问题文本必须唯一

validation.too_few_options.en-US: Error: Each question requires at least {minOptions} options
validation.too_few_options.zh-CN: 错误：每个问题至少需要 {minOptions} 个选项

validation.reserved_label.zh-CN: 错误：选项标签为保留标签（{labels}）

validation.duplicate_option_label.en-US: Error: Option labels must be unique within a question
validation.duplicate_option_label.zh-CN: 错误：同一问题中的选项标签必须唯一

envelope.suffix.en-US: You can now continue with the user's answers in mind.
envelope.suffix.zh-CN: 现在可以结合用户的回答继续执行。

config.invalid_collapse_key.zh-CN: {path} 中的 collapseKey 无效；改用 {fallback}

schema.option_label.en-US: MAX {maxLength} CHARACTERS. Concise display label (1-5 words) shown to the user.
schema.option_label.zh-CN: 最多 {maxLength} 个字符。向用户显示的简短标签（1-5 个词）。

schema.option_description.en-US: Explain what this option means and its trade-offs.
schema.option_description.zh-CN: 说明此选项的含义及其取舍。

schema.option_preview.en-US: Optional markdown preview for mockups, code snippets, diagrams, or configuration comparisons. Single-select only.
schema.option_preview.zh-CN: 可选 Markdown 预览，用于原型、代码片段、图表或配置比较；仅支持单选题。

schema.question.en-US: The complete, clear, specific question to ask the user.
schema.question.zh-CN: 要向用户提出的完整、清晰、具体的问题。

schema.header.en-US: MAX {maxLength} CHARACTERS. A very short chip or tag for the question.
schema.header.zh-CN: 最多 {maxLength} 个字符。问题的简短标签。

schema.options.en-US: Provide {minOptions}-{maxOptions} distinct choices. The custom-answer row is appended automatically.
schema.options.zh-CN: 提供 {minOptions}-{maxOptions} 个不同选项。自定义回答行会自动附加。

schema.multi_select.en-US: Set true when the user may select multiple options.
schema.multi_select.zh-CN: 当用户可以选择多个选项时设为 true。

schema.questions.zh-CN: 要向用户提出的问题（1-{maxQuestions} 个）。
